subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.**

Let your son manage your business after your retirement.

options.text: Your business is being managed by your son after your retirement.
Your business can be managed by your son after your retirement.
Let your business be managed by your son after your retirement.
Let your retirement be managed by your son after your business.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Let your business be managed by your son after your retirement.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
 
• The passive structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form:
 
• '**Let**' at the start of the given sentence means '**allow**'.
 
• 
 
Voice Change Rule__: Let + Object (Nonliving) + V-3 + by + Object (Living)

 *Example:

 Help the poor people. (Active Voice)

 Let the poor people be helped. (Passive Voice)*

 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'your son'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'your business'. 
 
• **The subject **will be put in place of the **object** and the **object** will be put in place of the **subject**.
 
• '**managed**' will be changed into **'be managed'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 
 
 

**__Correct Sentence__:** *Let your business be managed by your son after your retirement.*
